item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera buys a packet of table salt from a shop in Jaipur. The label on the packet says '100% pure salt'. Her science teacher explains that in science the word 'pure' has a special meaning. Which statement about the salt in the packet is correct?

options.A: The salt is a pure substance in science because the label says it is pure.
options.B: The salt is a pure substance in science only if it contains just one kind of substance with nothing else mixed in it.
options.C: The salt cannot be a pure substance in science because it is sold in a shop.
options.D: The salt is a pure substance in science because it looks clean and white.
